description.en:
Xiao Mo (小墨) is the name Spirit AI uses for its robot in a reported battery-production deployment at CATL's Zhongzhou site. The company describes the system as part of an embodied-intelligence production workflow, combining perception, decision-making and controlled physical execution for flexible manufacturing work.

Spirit AI's account emphasizes adapting to variation on the line and refining capabilities with process data. The reported production results apply to that configured workflow. Xiao Mo's exact hardware relationship to other Moz-series catalog entries should be confirmed before comparing model specifications or counting it as a separate product generation.
